faqs.question: What is ClaIR™?

faqs.answer: ClaIR™ captures fluorescence spectra from 900 to 1600 nm. Its absorbance measurement range is 500 to 1600 nm.

faqs.question: Can ClaIR™ measure both absorbance and fluorescence?

faqs.question: What microplate format does ClaIR™ support?

faqs.question: Can ClaIR™ use a tunable light source?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system includes a fiber entry for an optional tunable light source.

faqs.question: What is the focal height resolution of ClaIR™?

faqs.question: What read height does ClaIR™ support?

faqs.question: What data format does ClaIR™ provide?

faqs.question: What voltage does ClaIR™ require?

longForm.heroHook: Capture Full NIR-II Fluorescence Spectra from 900 to 1600 nm
longForm.heroLead: NIR-II probes can emit beyond the visible and near-infrared ranges used by conventional fluorescence systems. To validate these probes properly, researchers need more than a single detection wavelength. They need access to the fluorescence spectrum across the relevant infrared region. Photon etc. ClaIR™ is a NIR-II infrared microplate reader designed to capture full fluorescence spectra from 900 to 1600 nm in a 96-well plate format. It combines laser-based fluorescence excitation with a high-sensitivity VIS and IR spectrometer for spectral characterization of infrared-emitting probes and materials. ClaIR™ supports both fluorescence and absorbance spectroscopy. Fluorescence measurements use 650 nm and 735 nm laser diodes, while an optional tunable light source can be connected through the integrated fiber entry. Absorbance measurements cover 500 to 1600 nm using a halogen white lamp. With ANSI/SLAS-compliant 96-well plate compatibility, adjustable focal height, USB connectivity, and CSV data output, ClaIR™ brings NIR-II spectral analysis into a standardized microplate workflow.

sections.title: Why NIR-II Detection Matters
body: Why full-spectrum NIR-II fluorescence detection matters for probe research

NIR-II fluorescence measurements require detection in a wavelength region that extends beyond conventional visible fluorescence. When a probe's emission lies in the infrared, measuring only at a selected wavelength can limit the information available about its spectral behaviour.
ClaIR™ is designed to capture fluorescence spectra from 900 to 1600 nm, allowing researchers to examine the emission profile across the NIR-II region supported by the system.

This is particularly relevant for researchers developing or characterizing NIR-II fluorescent probes, infrared-emitting materials, and nanomaterials where the spectral position and shape of the emission are important research parameters.
The system also supports absorbance measurements from 500 to 1600 nm, extending spectral characterization from the visible into the infrared.
rows: Spectral capture across the supported NIR-II range
Optional tunable light source through fiber entry
groups.note: For probe evaluation, provide the expected excitation wavelength, emission range, sample format, and whether absorbance measurement is also required. This helps determine whether the ClaIR™ configuration matches the measurement workflow.

groups.title: Flexible Excitation for NIR-II Probe Characterization
groups.description: Built-in laser excitation with optional tunable illumination
body: Excitation wavelength is an important part of fluorescence characterization. Different probes and materials may require different excitation conditions, so ClaIR™ provides two built-in laser excitation wavelengths and an option for additional tunable illumination.
The system includes 650 nm and 735 nm laser diodes for fluorescence excitation. A fiber entry provides the option to connect a tunable light source when additional excitation flexibility is required.
This configuration allows the excitation side of the measurement to be considered alongside the probe's emission characteristics.
groups.note: When requesting a configuration, provide the probe's excitation wavelength and expected emission range. This allows the available excitation and detection configuration to be evaluated together.

groups.title: Absorbance and Fluorescence in One Platform
groups.description: Measure both optical response and infrared fluorescence in a 96-well workflow
body: ClaIR™ supports absorbance and fluorescence spectroscopy, allowing researchers to work with both measurement modes in one microplate reader.

For absorbance, the system uses a halogen white lamp and covers 500 to 1600 nm. For fluorescence, the system uses 650 nm and 735 nm laser diode excitation and detects fluorescence from 900 to 1600 nm.
This combination extends the measurement workflow across visible and infrared wavelengths.

paragraphs: ClaIR™ is built around the 96-well microplate format, supporting plates that comply with ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 through 6-2012.
This format allows researchers to organize samples within a standardized plate layout while using fluorescence or absorbance spectroscopy for measurement.

The system includes focal height adjustment with 0.1 mm resolution and an adjustable read height from the bottom to the middle of the well. These features provide control over the measurement position within the plate.
sections.note: For configuration discussions, share the plate type, sample format, expected fluorescence range, and whether fluorescence, absorbance, or both measurements are required.
